hero.eyebrow: In the heart of Europe since 2010
hero.subtitle: Immigration, study and investor residency in Hungary, with a team that guides every case personally and closely.
hero.image_alt: A city view in the heart of Europe

intro.statement: Since 2010, from the heart of Europe in Hungary, we have walked beside our clients on the road to immigration and a new life in Europe.
intro.text: From school and university admissions to setting up or buying a business and residency through investment, our team works with precision and up-to-date knowledge to guide you all the way to residence in Hungary. Every immigration journey is unique, so we shape our services around your needs and goals. We are here, with honesty, commitment and continuous support, to turn your concerns into confidence and your goals into reality.

paths.title: Four routes, one destination
paths.text: Every family and every person has their own circumstances. Together we find the route that fits you.

items.title: Hungarian visa: a gateway to the heart of Europe
items.text: A Hungarian visa is the first step into a world of new opportunities, whether for study, work or an unforgettable trip. Beyond Hungary itself, it also lets you travel across the Schengen area.
items.image_alt: A European cityscape in golden-hour light

items.title: Immigration to Hungary: a safe road ahead
items.text: If you are looking for new opportunities to live and do business in Europe, Hungary, one of the most dynamic countries in the European Union, may be your best choice. We stay beside you at every stage.
items.image_alt: Historic architecture in a European city

items.title: Study in Hungary: a bridge to an international future
items.text: Studying in Hungary from grade 9 through university is possible without a language certificate, so students can begin their path without the stress of foreign language exams.
items.image_alt: An urban campus setting in Europe

items.title: Hungary Golden Visa: 10-year investor residence
items.text: The Guest Investor Residence programme gives you and your family a 10-year permit, renewable once, in the heart of Europe, with no minimum stay requirement.

items.title: One conversation, the whole route
items.text: From the first call to the day you receive your residence card, one dedicated team manages every step of your case.

items.title: Truly on the ground in Budapest
items.text: Our office is in Budapest, so we know Hungarian rules and authorities first-hand and up to date.

items.title: Precision at every stage
items.text: A professional review of your case before any step is the core of our service, so nothing is left to chance.

items.title: Honesty and transparency
items.text: We set out the conditions, costs and risks clearly before you begin.

spotlight.title: Guest Investor Residence
spotlight.text: Hungary's official Guest Investor Residence Permit is one of the most attractive long-term residency routes in the European Union for investors and their families.

specs.label: Family members
specs.value: Spouse, children under 18 and dependent parents

specs.label: Schengen travel
specs.value: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period

specs.label: Work and business
specs.value: Permitted to work and do business

advantages.title: Life in the heart of Europe
advantages.text: Hungary is a member of the European Union and the Schengen area: a safe country with a reasonable cost of living and easy access to all of Europe.

items.title: Access to Schengen
items.text: Hungarian residence permit holders can travel visa-free across the Schengen area for short stays.

items.title: A recognised bilingual diploma
items.text: Students can earn a bilingual diploma recognised in Europe, the US and Iran, alongside an A-Level diploma at the same time.

items.title: Residence for the whole family
items.text: Your spouse and children under 18 can receive residence together with the main applicant and enjoy European life.
items.image_alt: A calm scene of life in Europe

items.title: Business in the European Union
items.text: By registering a company or buying an active business, you grow your capital and open the way to residency at the same time.

global.title: Your route to Budapest
global.text: Whether you are in Tehran or Dubai, Istanbul or Baghdad, your case is handled from day one by our office in Budapest.
